title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Savings Terms: Finch Circle Discount, Free-Delivery Threshold and Upgrade Credit
content:
Three terms of Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery reduce what a customer pays for delivery, and each is set per service level: whether the customer's Finch Circle home delivery discount percentage applies to that level's fees; the order merchandise subtotal at or above which the level's base fee is waived; and whether an order that qualifies for free Threshold Delivery gets the Threshold Delivery base fee credited toward that higher level.

## Terms by service level

| Service level | Finch Circle home delivery discount applies to this level's fees | Order merchandise subtotal at or above which this level's base fee is waived | Order qualifying for free Threshold Delivery gets the Threshold Delivery base fee credited toward this level |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | Yes | Not applicable | No |
| Threshold Delivery | Yes | $2,999.00 | No |
| Room of Choice Delivery | Yes | Not applicable | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery | Yes | Not applicable | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | Yes | Not applicable | Yes |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | Yes | Not applicable | Yes |

## Reading the terms

- **Finch Circle discount.** It applies at all six levels. The percentage itself belongs to the Finch Circle tier the customer holds, not to the delivery service level.
- **Free-delivery threshold.** Only Threshold Delivery has a threshold of its own: an order merchandise subtotal of 2999 dollars ($2,999.00) or more waives the Threshold Delivery base fee. The amount is in US dollars to the cent. At the other five levels the entry is not applicable.
- **Upgrade credit.** Room of Choice Delivery, White Glove Delivery, White Glove Delivery with Assembly and Premier White Glove with Haul-Away are the levels at which an order that qualifies for free Threshold Delivery gets the Threshold Delivery base fee credited toward the higher level. Curbside Delivery and Threshold Delivery do not carry this credit.

## Subtotal against the $2,999.00 threshold (hypothetical orders)

| Order merchandise subtotal | At or above $2,999.00? |
|---|---|
| $2,998.99 | No |
| $2,999.00 | Yes |
| $3,450.00 | Yes |
